description_en: Retrieves a list of asynchronous tasks
kebab_example: aliyun aimiaobi list-async-tasks --agent-key cd327c3d5d5e44159cc716e23bfa530e_p_beebot_public --task-name '任务名称' --task-code MaterialDocumentUpload --task-type '暂无' --task-status 1 --task-status-list 1 --task-type-list test --create-time-start 2023-02-19_07:28:11 --create-time-end 2023-03-18_02:00:00 --current 1 --size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAsyncTasks

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the workspace: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587494.html
parameters.name: agent_key

parameters.help_en: A term query for the task name
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: A term query for the task code
parameters.name: task_code

parameters.help_en: A term query for the task type
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: A term query for the task status. Valid values: 0 (Pending), 1 (Running), 2 (Succeeded), 3 (Paused), 4 (Failed and retriable), 5 (Failed and not retriable), and 6 (Canceled)
parameters.help_zh: 任务状态精确查询 (0: 待执行, 1: 执行中, 2: 成功, 3: 暂停, 4: 失败可重试, 5: 失败不可重试, 6: 取消)
parameters.name: task_status

parameters.help_en: A term query for a list of task statuses. Valid values: 0 (Pending), 1 (Running), 2 (Succeeded), 3 (Paused), 4 (Failed and retriable), 5 (Failed and not retriable), and 6 (Canceled)
parameters.help_zh: 任务状态列表精确查询 (0: 待执行, 1: 执行中, 2: 成功, 3: 暂停, 4: 失败可重试, 5: 失败不可重试, 6: 取消)
parameters.name: task_status_list

parameters.help_en: A term query for a list of task types
parameters.help_zh: 任务类型列表精确查询
parameters.name: task_type_list

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range to query task creation times. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 任务创建时间 开始查询,格式为：YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: create_time_start

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query task creation times. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 任务创建时间 结束查询,格式为：YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: create_time_end

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: size
